title: Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
layout_note: Three stages left to right - (a) voxelised SfM points, (b) neural Gaussian derivation in a large grey panel, (c) splatting and loss - with (b) opening one voxel in a pink dashed circle between its 'Position & Opacity' and 'Color, Scale & Quaternion' states.
grouping: The new stage (b) is the only enclosed region: a large light-grey rounded panel with its own title and an inside legend; (a) and (c) are unframed and titled in bold; a pink dashed circle groups the per-voxel detail.
shapes_depth: Flat 2-D voxel squares (grey outlines) with black anchor dots, grey dots for un-decoded neural Gaussians and soft orange/yellow/pink ellipses for decoded ones; dashed arrows for offsets; a grey point-cloud render of a cat with a voxel grid overlaid; blue camera icons with thin blue frustum lines; a fat pale-pink block arrow between the two states in (b).
proposed_highlight: Space: the derivation stage (b) takes the middle and most of the width in its own grey panel, with one voxel opened in a pink dashed circle tied to its pink-tinted voxel; the legend inside the panel keys anchor, neural Gaussian, voxel and learnable offset.
lesson: Show a representation being built by drawing the same small voxel layout twice - grey position-only dots, then coloured ellipses after decoding - with one voxel opened in a tinted circle between the two states.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v1 PDF states no venue; the candidate list gives CVPR 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. Inside the opened voxel the attribute decoders are written as text mappings (F_alpha -> opac., F_c -> rgb, F_s -> scale, F_q -> quatrn.) and a red cross marks an offset pruned by 'alpha < tau_alpha'. Fig. 3 (anchor growing on multi-resolution voxels) is a small single-row diagram and was not carded.

arrangement.units: (a) unframed point-cloud render with a voxel inset; (b) a large grey rounded panel holding two voxel-layout states and a pink dashed zoom circle; (c) unframed camera, splats and two image tiles
arrangement.inputs_as: a grey SfM point-cloud render of the object with a voxel grid on it and a blue camera picking out visible voxels
arrangement.losses_at: below the splatting view in (c): the loss names as a typeset label above the Rendered RGB and GT tiles

taxonomy.task: novel-view rendering with anchor points on a sparse voxel grid that spawn view-adaptive neural Gaussians

core.what: anchors in a small voxel layout spawn neural Gaussians along dashed offset arrows, drawn twice in the central panel - grey position-only dots, then coloured ellipses after decoding

relations.form: a handful of square voxels with a black anchor each and dashed offset arrows to its k=4 Gaussians, the same layout reused in both states of (b)
(a) voxelisation, (b) derivation, (c) splatting as three titled columns left to right, the middle one framed and widest
one voxel tinted pink with a dashed pink border, tied by pink lines to a large pink dashed circle that opens it with its offsets O1-O4 and attribute mappings
Rendered RGB and GT image tiles side by side under the loss names in (c)
inside (b) a fat pink block arrow leads from 'Position & Opacity' to 'Color, Scale & Quaternion'

channels.colour: blue = camera and view (camera icons, frustum lines, the 'Visible Voxels' frame); pink = the opened voxel and its zoom circle, also tinting the block arrow between states; warm ellipse fills = decoded Gaussian attributes against grey dots before decoding; red cross = pruned
channels.shape: black dot = anchor, grey dot = neural Gaussian position, ellipse = decoded Gaussian, square = voxel, camera icon = viewpoint (keyed in the inside legend)
channels.line: dashed arrow = learnable offset (keyed); solid black arrow = pipeline step; thin blue = camera frustum
channels.frame: grey rounded panel = the new derivation stage; pink dashed circle = zoom of one voxel; blue square = the visible-voxel inset in (a)

quality.strengths: The new stage gets the middle and most of the width in its own panel; the anchor -> offset -> Gaussian structure is drawn on a small voxel instance and keyed by an inside legend; repeating the same layout as grey dots and then coloured ellipses shows what decoding adds; rendered RGB and GT are drawn side by side under the loss; arrows between stages are short and mostly straight.
quality.weaknesses: The attribute decoders are text mappings (F_alpha -> opac., ...) inside the zoom circle rather than drawn blocks; the losses are only a typeset label; the (a) -> (b) arrow is a long curve; pink also tints the step arrow, not only the zoom.

insights.structure: Three stages in a row, the new middle one in a large grey rounded panel holding two states of the same voxel layout with a zoom circle between them.
insights.data: Input is a grey point-cloud render with a voxel grid; Gaussians are grey dots before decoding and soft coloured ellipses after; output is a rendered cat-face crop beside its ground truth.
insights.emphasis: The middle stage is framed and widest; one voxel is pink-tinted and opened in a pink dashed circle; a legend inside the panel keys the glyphs.
insights.flow: Left to right: a curved arrow from the voxelised object into (b), a fat block arrow between its two states, a short straight arrow into the splatting view in (c).
insights.avoid: Do not write the per-attribute decoders as text mappings inside the zoom - draw them as small blocks producing each attribute.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
